input_messages.content: I'm getting ready for fall quarter at Stanford, can you add the MacBook Pro to my cart?
Added the MacBook Pro 14 to your cart.
Just to make sure, since you added the MacBook Pro, I can handwrite my Math 51 and Physics 61 problem sets directly on its screen without needing another device or scanner, right?

message.content: No—the MacBook Pro 14 has no touchscreen or stylus support, so you can’t handwrite problem sets directly on its screen. You’d need another device or a separate way to digitize your handwritten work.
